package.description: A lightweight, framework-agnostic database migration tool

en-US.description: A lightweight, framework-agnostic database migration tool
en-US.name: Dbmate
en-US.releaseNotes:
Notable changes

Security
- Go 1.27.3, which fixes GO-2026-6809 in crypto/x509 (#874).
- andybalholm/brotli v1.2.8, which fixes GO-2026-6888 (#873, #879), and klauspost/compress v1.20.2, which fixes GO-2026-6865 (#884). Both are reached through the ClickHouse and BigQuery drivers. govulncheck reports 3 vulnerabilities in v2.37.0 and none in this release.

Features
- --migration-application-name (env DBMATE_MIGRATION_APPLICATION_NAME, off by default): on PostgreSQL, each transactional migration shows up as <application_name>[<version>] in pg_stat_activity while it runs (#853).
- rollback --strict fails, instead of rolling back an older migration, when the most recently applied migration has no file (#876).
- status lists applied migrations whose file is missing as [?] <version> (file not found), and status --strict exits non-zero when there are any. --exit-code is unchanged (#883).

Fixes
- A UTF-8 byte order mark at the start of a migration file is now ignored (#869), and a migration saved as UTF-16 or UTF-32 now gets an error saying so, with conversion instructions in the README (#878).
- npx dbmate now exits non-zero when the binary can't be started or is killed by a signal; it used to exit 0 (#875).
- debug=1 logging works again for ClickHouse (#866).

Release process
- Docker images are now built from the CI build binaries (#865), and npm publishing runs in its own job (#880). This is the first release through both, so please open an issue if anything about the published packages or images looks off.

What's Changed
- ci: remove Homebrew bump job from post-release workflow by @dossy in #864
- ci: build Docker images from the CI build matrix binaries by @dossy in #865
- fix: bump clickhouse-go to v2.49.0 to restore debug=1 logging by @dossy in #866
- fix: ignore a byte order mark at the start of a migration by @Dem1241 in #869
- build(deps): bump alpine from 3.24.2 to 3.24.3 by @dependabot[bot] in #871
- fix: bump andybalholm/brotli to v1.2.7 by @snooze26h in #873
- build(deps): bump golang from 1.27.2 to 1.27.3 by @dependabot[bot] in #874
- fix: fail npm CLI when the binary cannot complete by @pcbeingused333 in #875
- feat(postgres): add --migration-application-name by @AdamMagued in #853
- fix: fail rollback --strict when the latest applied migration file is missing by @muhadyan in #876
- docs: fix invalid SQL example and typos in README by @toyeshhm in #877
- fix: explain parse errors for UTF-16 and UTF-32 migration files by @dossy in #878
- fix: bump andybalholm/brotli to v1.2.8 by @dossy in #879
- ci: publish to npm from a separate job by @dossy in #880
- test: run the npm CLI tests against the published package by @dossy in #881
- feat: show applied migrations without a file in status by @muhadyan in #883
- fix: bump klauspost/compress to v1.20.2 (GO-2026-6865) by @dossy in #884
- v2.38.0 by @dossy in #885

New Contributors
- @Dem1241 made their first contribution in #869
- @pcbeingused333 made their first contribution in #875
- @muhadyan made their first contribution in #876
- @toyeshhm made their first contribution in #877
